test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A new laptop was bought by me yesterday.

options.text: I bought a new laptop yesterday.
I was bought a new laptop yesterday.
I have buy a new laptop yesterday.
I have been buying a laptop yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In Active Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• **In Passive Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and **'A new laptop' **is the subject and **'me' **is the object.
